# Building Apps

Create an app, use hooks, extend other apps, ship fixtures and patches, and translate.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Apps](apps.md) | Create a Frappe app, understand its files and folders, install it on a site, and build its assets. |
| [Hooks](hooks.md) | How hooks.py works, how hook values from all apps merge, and the hooks that apps use most. |
| [Extending Other Apps](extending-apps.md) | Change the behavior of DocTypes and methods from another app with doc_events, controller overrides and mixins, method overrides, doctype_js, custom fields and property setters. |
| [Fixtures and Patches](fixtures-and-patches.md) | Ship records with an app through the fixtures hook, change data on existing sites with patches, and understand the order of bench migrate. |
| [Translations](translations.md) | Mark strings with _() in Python and __() in JS, use context and lazy strings, keep PO/POT files in an app, and run the bench translation commands. |
